conditions: A consulate stamp is accepted. The copy must be attested by the UAE consulate in the country of origin.
If a UAE residence permit has not yet been issued, the entry stamp and a passport copy are temporarily accepted.
Free zone licenses only. A physical office is mandatory for mainland companies.
IFZA: the simplified form is accepted if turnover is at most AED 3M and there are at most 9 employees.
If the founder is outside the UAE, a draft MOA can be submitted with a power of attorney. Notarization is completed later.
A short written description is sufficient in some free zones. Zones such as DMCC require a full plan.
If the current sponsor will not issue an NOC, the process can proceed with a resignation letter and the new sponsor's approval.
